column3: NASB follows the critical text; “were asking” is rendered “were urging.”
NASB renders the question expecting “no” as “No one brought Him anything to eat, did he?”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “then.” It joins “already” to the next verse.
NASB follows the critical text and begins with “Already” from v. 35; “reward” is rendered “wages.”
NASB follows the critical text; “in this” is rendered “in this case.”
NASB follows the critical text without “the Christ”; “speech” is rendered “what you said.”
NASB follows the critical text; “hometown” is rendered “country.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Jesus.”
NASB follows the critical text; “was about to die” is rendered “was at the point of death.”
NASB follows the critical text; “was going” is rendered “started off.”
NASB follows the critical text; “servants” is rendered “slaves,” and “boy” is “son.”
